Resolution: the $274-278 zone is the actionable consensus for this run, consistent with the existing pending order at $276. (2) TARGET DIVERGENCE: swing_mean_reversion targets $285.5 (near-term, 3-7 days) while swing_breakout ($296.77) and swing_catalyst_news ($298) target the fuller post-earnings drift move. The mean_reversion agent is flagging that the short-term is overextended and only a modest bounce is likely before another pause; the breakout/catalyst agents are sizing for the structural move. The other 4 agents are primarily technically-driven and treat macro as a background factor. This disagreement tells us: AAPL's idiosyncratic strength (record margins, earnings beat, $100B buyback, relative outperformance) is real, but the external macro environment could trigger a broader market risk-off that drags even outperformers lower. The macro agent's cautious-bullish read is not a veto but warrants the confidence cap and reinforces entry discipline — do not chase above $280.
